user_direction: 较快节奏、非常抓耳的旋律，通过旋律本身让玩家感到正在作战。
workspace: 积木战争 · 原创配乐候选
exclude_styles: vocals, singing, humming, choir, chanting, spoken words, ambient, cozy village music, pastoral, lullaby, stealth music, slow tempo, half-time feel, long intro, percussion-only sections, drone, atonal, trailer risers, EDM drops, battle sound effects

tracks.title: 积木战争 V2-01｜赤旗冲锋
tracks.direction: 旋律主导的管弦战斗进行曲
tracks.use: 主战斗风格候选；派兵、抢点、双方交战
tracks.prompt: Instrumental MELODY-LED fantasy RTS BATTLE THEME. Fast 146 BPM, driving 4/4, lively martial momentum. Lead with an irresistible, hummable original 8-bar combat tune in the FIRST TWO BARS. A punchy rising-fourth call, repeated-note rhythmic hook and descending answer; repeat the hook clearly, then develop it. Bright horns and clarinet double the melody, answered by bold violins and nimble bassoon. Racing string eighth-notes, plucked bass and crisp marching snare propel it; percussion supports the tune. Minor-key urgency, dominant tension, confident melodic resolutions: troops charging and contesting territory. Colorful, plucky, determined, full of forward motion. Keep a clear prominent lead melody throughout. A-A-B-A form, brief 8-bar contrasting tune, triumphant return without slowing down. Compact folk-orchestral game sound, punchy and clean. Three-minute continuous combat cue, loop-oriented ending.

tracks.title: 积木战争 V2-02｜夺桥疾行
tracks.direction: 快弦乐与木管的民谣战斗主题
tracks.use: 快速调兵、绕后、桥头争夺
tracks.prompt: Instrumental fast FOLK-ORCHESTRAL COMBAT THEME, 152 BPM, urgent galloping 4/4. A catchy original fiddle-and-wooden-flute battle melody is the star, loud and clear from the first bar. Build a memorable 4-bar hook with a repeated rhythmic call, an upward leap and a tight descending reply; play it twice so it sticks. Fierce rhythmic fiddle bowing, bright shawm answers, mandolin offbeats and fast cello ostinato create nimble attack-and-counterattack motion. Crisp field snare and small toms support the melody. Minor-mode tension with bold dominant turns; adventurous little armies rushing a bridge, spirited and competitive. Keep the melody singing above the rhythm, with short woodwind-brass responses and decisive accents. A-A-B-A tune structure; contrasting section stays fast and returns quickly to the main hook. Vivid acoustic game-battle arrangement, clear lead, stable energy for three minutes, loop-oriented close.

tracks.title: 积木战争 V2-03｜逆势反击
tracks.direction: 抓耳号角与弦乐的反击主题
tracks.use: 中后期反击、2v2 与 3v3 联盟推进
tracks.prompt: Instrumental ANTHEMIC MELODIC strategy-game BATTLE MUSIC, fast 140 BPM, firm driving 4/4. Begin immediately with an unforgettable original brass-and-violin combat hook: a short repeated-note rallying call, rising minor-key melody and a bold answering descent. A complete hummable 8-bar theme, clearly repeated, then varied; make the tune itself feel like a counterattack. Trumpets and French horns state it with biting staccato articulation, soaring violins take it over, clarinet adds quick replies. Running string ostinatos, active bass and tight military snare keep urgent forward momentum. Tense dominant chords resolve into defiant minor-key confidence. Spirited, courageous, competitive, colorful rather than solemn. Foreground the lead tune across A-A-B-A sections, with only brief melodic contrasts. Three-minute continuous battle cue, clear punchy orchestral mix, immediate action, steady tempo and loop-oriented return.

user_feedback: 认可《夺桥疾行》A 版的节奏引入，但整轮过吵、节奏过快，能量起伏与旋律需要继续改善。
